title: The Fall of Constantinople — source-paced visual short

narration.voice_speed: clear, engaging and natural; not slow or overcompressed

reference_pacing: 63-66 second uploaded user examples; minimalist purposeful 3D movement, clear environmental geography
required_release_checks: every spoken clause has visible event or object within its exact shot
each beat has independently reviewed first/middle/end frames
no generic walls, fake historic landmarks or empty footage in place of named event
no audio dead air, clipped Qwen speech, wrong-timed foley, or speeding voices to fit
correct period clothing, building silhouettes, light and geography checked by human
all downloaded assets have verified commercial licenses and checksums
do not publish until user visually approves

asset_candidates.use: fire and smoke flipbooks (verify source manifest)

shots.spoken: In 1453, Constantinople was shielded by some of the world's strongest walls.
shots.caption: CONSTANTINOPLE • 1453
shots.required_visible_action: Establish the real spatial relationship of walled city, Golden Horn, Bosporus and approach from west.

shots.spoken: Deep moats and two lines of stone defenses made any assault dangerous.
shots.caption: THE THEODOSIAN WALLS
shots.required_visible_action: Travel over a cutaway showing moat, lower outer wall and taller inner wall in correct order.

shots.spoken: Then Sultan Mehmed the Second brought an Ottoman army to the city's outskirts.
shots.caption: MEHMED II'S SIEGE
shots.required_visible_action: Reveal siege camp and gun emplacements outside the walls, without modern or fantasy troops.

shots.spoken: His enormous cannons fired stone balls powerful enough to damage the fortifications.
shots.caption: STONE SHOT VS STONE WALL
shots.required_visible_action: Show a single heavy bombard firing then cut to the stone ball impacting the wall and masonry dust.

shots.spoken: Between attacks, defenders frantically repaired gaps in the walls to stay alive.
shots.caption: REPAIRING THE WALLS
shots.required_visible_action: Show defenders adding timber, earth and masonry to a breach before the next impact.

shots.spoken: The Byzantines also stretched a heavy chain across the Golden Horn harbor.
shots.caption: THE CHAIN BLOCKED THE HARBOUR
shots.required_visible_action: Show the harbor mouth and defensive chain physically stretched across water, stopping incoming ships.

shots.spoken: Unable to enter by water, Mehmed ordered ships dragged across the land.
shots.caption: THE OVERLAND SOLUTION
shots.required_visible_action: Show an unambiguous land route from one shoreline over a hill to the protected harbor.

shots.spoken: Greased timber tracks carried vessels over the hills, past the harbor chain.
shots.caption: SHIPS OVER THE HILL
shots.required_visible_action: View the rollers rotating beneath period galleys as crews pull them up and down the hill.

shots.spoken: When ships appeared inside the harbor, defenders had another front to protect.
shots.caption: THE SHIPS REACH THE HORN
shots.required_visible_action: Show a ship entering Golden Horn water inside the blockade with defenders facing the new threat.

shots.spoken: After weeks of fighting, Ottoman soldiers launched a final assault on May twenty-ninth.
shots.caption: 29 MAY • FINAL ASSAULT
shots.required_visible_action: Show attackers advancing toward an existing breach at dawn, not a closed, intact gate.

shots.spoken: At the battered defenses, attackers broke through and captured the city.
shots.caption: THE WALLS ARE BREACHED
shots.required_visible_action: Physically show the attackers passing through the damaged sector, with no teleporting or static wall shot.

shots.spoken: The Byzantine Empire ended, and Constantinople became an Ottoman imperial capital.
shots.caption: THE BYZANTINE EMPIRE ENDS
shots.required_visible_action: Pull back over the intact city geography and transition to a restrained historically labelled closing view.
